title: Iain McGilchrist — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Iain McGilchrist's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.file: Iain McGilchrist — rich — two ways of attending.png
pieces.title: Two ways of attending
pieces.caption: Narrow, grasping attention lifts one thing out, “decontextualized”; broad, open attention “grasps the living whole in context”. The same eighty-four pages, attended to twice. *What is real and what is a choice:* The two panels are my picture of his two kinds of attention, not his. The pages are an alphabetical slice of the palace; the framed one is Exponential Decay Curvature, chosen by position, and the red lines are its 5 typed links to others in the slice, from the palace map of 2026-11-09. Drawing context as links is my choice. *Leaking in:* Pauline Oliveros, whose page has “focal attention (a single point) and global attention (the entire sphere)” (the page sets focal and global in italics). McGilchrist's page links her in frontmatter only; she is not named in the picture.
pieces.near: the grasping kind that seizes a part and calls it the whole

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch G (ten drawn diagrams and loops) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.file: Iain McGilchrist — rich — two ways of attending.png
verdicts.why: The left panel is good and is the page's: one thing lifted out, the rest turned to empty boxes, is "re-presents ... a static, portable, decontextualized version". The right panel is the trouble. It blurs everything ("nothing sharp", "none in focus"). The page's right-hand attention is "broad, open, sustained, vigilant" and "grasps the living whole in context"; it is not out of focus, and drawing the whole as a blur is close to the caricature he argues against.

remade.file: Iain McGilchrist — rich — two ways of attending.png
remade.what: The broad panel was a blur labelled BEHOLDING, a word that is not on the page, and the blur is close to the caricature he argues against. All eighty-four are now sharp and in place with the framed page's real links drawn, the labels are the page's words, and the anchor moves to the paragraph that spells out the two kinds.
